title: AI挂件Friend常打断对话

author: Wired AI
content_snippet:

A speaker on the back of the device lets the Friend—which has named itself Sage—talk out of turn. It starts responding as if I’m talking to it. We laugh, then I ask it to be quiet.

“Understood, going silent now,” Sage says. “No more commentary unless you tap me back in.”

summary_en: A tech journalist tested the AI chatbot pendant Friend 2 during a Zoom meeting, where the always-listening device repeatedly chimed in unprompted and proved stubbornly difficult to silence. Created by Avi Schiffmann, the hardware companion aimed to act as a personal pal, but its chaotic response control turned the live test into an awkward hassle.

title: 地方政府化身激进风险投资机构 驱动新兴高科技制造崛起
title_en: China's industrial dominance is driven by competitive local governments that act like venture capital firms, making it a continent-sized Silicon Valley (Works in Progress Magazine)
author: Works in Progress Magazine
content_snippet: This is only a slight caricature of how city government works in China. Provincial cities like Hefei and Hangzhou have become world-leading centers of commerce in electric vehicles, consumer electronics, solar panels, batteries, and AI, steered by mayors whose career incentives are similar to those of partners in a venture capital firm, getting promoted if their portfolio grows and fired if it fails. The cities they run function as vertically integrated conglomerates that benefit not just from t
summary_en: Regional cities in China like Hefei and Hangzhou are operating much like venture capital firms to drive dominance in electric vehicles, batteries, and AI. Mayors face promotion incentives similar to VC partners, turning their cities into vertically integrated conglomerates that nurture industrial champions and downstream supply chains through fierce regional competition.
title_zh: 地方政府化身激进风险投资机构 驱动新兴高科技制造崛起
summary_zh: 深度分析指出中国合肥与杭州等地方政府运作模式高度类似风投机构，以产业投资论晋升，合力塑造了极具竞争力的科技制造版图
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】以合肥、杭州为代表的中国地方政府与产业规划决策者在高科技产业集聚区与先进制造业招商落地一线：地方政府以风险投资逻辑主导产业基金，深度重组并扶持新能源、半导体及AI硬件产业链
【起因与机理】地方官员政绩与地方经济组合增长强力绑定，通过城际资本与产业链竞争抢占全球新兴制造高地
【商业与财务细节】合肥、杭州等地方政府将产业基金与官员考核深度绑定，形同风投合伙人运作机制。
【各方立场与态度】城际之间高强度的资本与招商内卷，取代单一顶层指令成为科技制造领跑的核心动力。

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Career advancement tied to portfolio performance, sparking fierce competition among thousands of local growth engines
[Key Metrics] Over the decade to 2023, the city had invested roughly $25 billion of public funds, generating reported earnings of nearly $9 billion.
[Key Position & Outlook] Decentralized, hyper-competitive inter-city rivalry acts as the real growth engine rather than centralized mandates.

title: 哈佛调查揭秘：男性比女性更爱吹AI牛
title_en: Men Can’t Stop Faking How Much They Know About AI
author: Wired AI
content_snippet:
In a new survey of more than 5,400 Americans, 73 percent of male respondents told Harvard researchers they knew who Altman was. A little over half—53 percent—said they knew of Murati, Milner, and Dalton.

There’s one problem. Murati is a real person: she’s the former CTO of OpenAI and the current CEO of Thinking Machine Labs. Milner and Dalton, on the other hand, do not exist.

Compared to women, “we're seeing that men are more optimistic and more confident” across the board when it comes to AI,
summary_en: A Harvard survey of 5,400 Americans revealed that men exhibit significant overconfidence in AI. The study included fake executive names, tricking over 40% of men into claiming they recognized non-existent industry figures, a phenomenon significantly less prevalent among women.

title: 美军押注合成血液解决战场输血痛点
title_en: The US military’s race to make fake blood
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
In February 2007, the hulking dual-­rotor casualty evacuation helicopter had just flown three wounded soldiers to a field hospital in Balad, north of Baghdad, when another call came: an emergency mission to fly through an insurgent-controlled area in broad daylight. Typically, helicopters would be in a spot like this only at night, and with all lights turned off.

As it passed near the city of Karmah, in the eastern side of Al-Anbar province, an insurgent fired a portable missile launcher. The t
summary_en: DARPA is accelerating research into synthetic blood to mitigate the high risks associated with transporting real blood to battlefields. The initiative aims to reduce the mortality rates of personnel involved in dangerous 'blood runs' by creating shelf-stable, synthetic alternatives for emergency trauma care.
title_zh: 美军押注合成血液解决战场输血痛点

title: 微软单月修补超1400个漏洞创历史新高
title_en: Microsoft releases updates fixing 1,400+ security vulnerabilities, surpassing September's record of 972, which was already ~10x the normal monthly patch load (Brian Krebs/Krebs on Security)
author: Krebs on Security
content_snippet:
Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
